settings.title: What inspired Palera to be born?
settings.text:
Palera started with a tour we were doing on the Italian island "Sicily" in 2021, inspired by the glowing sun light on the blue wavy water.
We knew that we wanted to create a piece that can glow with the sun light, as the wavy water of Sicilian seaside did!
"Palera Milano was created to add brightness to your days and nights".

settings.title: Why did you start Palera Milano?
settings.text:
In order to explain this better, let me tell you a little bit about my journey, I have been founded and in love with handmade & craftsmanship since my childhood. I remember that I started creating cute little jewelry soon after I started walking.
I have since, studied and practiced different types of creativity and craftsmanship!
With Palera Milano, I get to do what I love every day and share my passion with you all.

settings.title: Where is Palera Milano based?
settings.text: We are based in Milano and all our production is in Italy. We only use materials of the highest quality to make sure your special items stand the test of time.

settings.title: How many hours does a bag take to be created?
settings.text:
It depends on the model. Only weaving the beads take between 1 day for a mini to 3 days for a maxi bag!
We weave up to 750 beads for a mini bag, 1200 beads for a maxi bag.

settings.title: Do you plan on creating other categories?
settings.text:
Creating beautiful pieces that complement our lifestyle” is in Palera’s DNA!
Bags are the center of our creations at the moment and we are developing new pieces that will complement the "Palera" bags as our latest Mirage Necklaces, and the Home Décor collections.

settings.title: How long does it take to receive my order?
settings.text: At Palera, we take pride in crafting each item specifically for you. Our made-to-order model ensures zero inventory waste and delivers a unique piece tailored to your preferences. Typically, there's a creation time before shipping, usually within one week. During peak seasons, this may be slightly extended, but rest assured, we'll keep you updated on shipping times once your order is placed. Feel free to chat with us for more details.

settings.title: How can I take care of Palera Bag?
settings.text:
Palera bags are created with a unique technique, developed over months of developments to make it strong and durable.
However, the best way to keep your beloved bag in its perfect condition, is to use it with care when carrying it, and store it with its original packaging when not in use.
When packed for travelling, make sure, it is well stuffed and not squeezed.

settings.title: Can I have a refund on a different card or bank account?
settings.text: For security reason, we can proceed with refunds only to the same account or card that the payment was done with.
